name: T-Mobile Order API - v2
description: The T-Mobile Order API v2 enables a wide range of orders including device purchases, new line activations, and service modifications. To complement order processing, the queryOrder api offers detailed tracking and visibility into order outcomes, providing insights into status, charges, line configurations, and shipment details for complete order lifecycle transparency.
